quote.text: El que se muere vivió, y el que perdió los ojos tuvo vista: bien se podrá hacer que las cosas que vinieron a nuestro poder no estén en él, pero no se podrá hacer que no hayan venido.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Just as one's experiences shape who we become, a child’s early encounters with love, discipline, and kindness become an inseparable part of their character; nurture these experiences, for they remain even when the external conditions change.
    • While you can guide and mold your child’s path, remember that every lesson they learn is a gift they will carry forever. Embrace both successes and failures as integral chapters of their ongoing story.
  • Leadership
    • A true leader understands that while external challenges may strip away many layers of influence, the history of one's decisions and actions remains indelible; cultivate wisdom in every choice you make.
    • Recognize that every experience—be it triumph or misstep—adds depth to your leadership. Cherish these moments, as they shape your legacy and enable you to inspire those who follow.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, every user experience, feedback, and iteration contributes to the product’s evolution—a body of work that no setback can erase, reflecting the cumulative journey of progress.
    • Accept that while market conditions might force sudden changes, the insights and hard-earned lessons from past endeavors are permanent assets. Use them to guide strategic decisions and innovate with confidence.
